rationale: Rahul and Anvitha both work at the intersection of robotics and computer vision — Rahul as a robotics engineer deploying systems in agricultural environments at AgRobotics, and Anvitha as a CV engineer with hands-on robotics experience including object detection and tracking. Anvitha's depth in computer vision (Python, C++, MATLAB) and embedded vision systems could complement Rahul's work on robotic field deployment, especially if AgRobotics' systems require vision-based perception for autonomous operation.
intro_message: Rahul, meet Anvitha Anchala — she's a computer vision engineer with robotics and embedded vision experience that could be relevant to AgRobotics' field robot deployment work.
